name: HA Lights Sync
description: Sync any Home Assistant light to music in real time, using Music Assistant's visualizer pipeline (the same beat/spectrum feed the built-in Hue Lights Sync plugin uses) and Home Assistant's own light.turn_on service - works with any light HA already controls (Kasa, Hue, LIFX, Zigbee, whatever), with zero extra setup beyond picking the entities.
